label: dormwar1
title_zh: 超级无敌究极宿舍大战！

lines.en: label dormwar1:
scene dormdecisions1
: Have any last words before your team is completely and utterly annihilated, Uta?
lines.zh: : 在你的队伍被彻彻底底碾碎之前，有什么遗言吗，Uta？

lines.en: : Look at you. The contest hasn’t even started yet and you’re already getting full of yourself.
lines.zh: : 看看你。比赛都还没开始呢，你就已经飘起来了。

lines.en: : And to think I once acknowledged you as a fellow glasses person.
lines.zh: : 而且想想看，我还曾经承认过你是眼镜同好呢。

lines.en: : Oh please. I was wearing glasses before you were even born.
lines.zh: : 哦得了吧。你还没出生，我就已经戴上眼镜了。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? What month were you born in?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？你是几月出生的？

lines.en: : December.
lines.zh: : 十二月。

lines.en: : And I was born in August, so that clearly wouldn’t be possible.
lines.zh: : 而我是八月出生的，所以那显然不可能。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions2
: Of what year, though? Because I could still technically be eight months older than you.
lines.zh: : 可那是哪一年呢？因为严格来说，我还是有可能比你大八个月的。

lines.en: : [[redacted].
lines.zh: : [[redacted]。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions3
: Wait, but if we were both born in [[redacted], that would mean...
lines.zh: : 等等，可如果我们俩都出生在 [[redacted]，那就意味着……

lines.en: : {i}I’ve{/i} been wearing glasses since before {i}you{/i} were born! Take that, smart girl!
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}从{i}你{/i}出生之前就开始戴眼镜了！接招吧，聪明丫头！

lines.en: : But...you’re so short...
lines.zh: : 可……你这么矮……

lines.en: : Are you really older than me?
lines.zh: : 你真的比我大吗？

lines.en: : Hey, is it just me or did anyone else hear them redact the year they were born?
lines.zh: : 嘿，只有我一个人听见她们把出生年份给消音了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I heard that too. That was weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也听见了。好奇怪。

lines.en: : Size has nothing to do with age, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 个子大小跟年龄没关系，Makoto。

lines.en: : But also, I didn’t start wearing glasses until middle[school], so you probably win if you’ve really been wearing them for that long.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我是到初中[school]才开始戴眼镜的，所以如果你真的戴了那么久，大概算你赢。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions4
: Wait, so does this mean the first floor gets a point?
lines.zh: : 等等，那这是不是意味着一楼得一分？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if they’re holding their own contest right now or not.
lines.zh: : 我分不清她们现在到底算不算在自己另开一场比赛。

lines.en: : I think we’re still deciding on the contests now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们现在还在决定比赛项目呢。

lines.en: : They’re just being weird and arguing with each other about glasses because like only three girls in our class wear them.
lines.zh: : 她们只是在犯傻、为眼镜吵架，因为我们班好像只有三个女生戴眼镜。

lines.en: : Which also means the second floor girls would win if we added up the time Nodoka’s spent wearing them, so...
lines.zh: : 也就是说，要是把 Nodoka 戴眼镜的年头也算上，二楼的女生就赢了，所以……

lines.en: : Actually, maybe this is the first contest. That’s fine by me.
lines.zh: : 其实，也许这就是第一场比赛。我没意见。

lines.en: : Excuse me. I have a question.
lines.zh: : 打扰一下。我有个问题。

lines.en: : Yes! Io! This is the first time I’ve ever heard you call out in class.
lines.zh: : 好呀！Io！这可是我第一次听见你在课堂上主动发言。

lines.en: : Can I be excused? I don’t want to be a part of...whatever this is.
lines.zh: : 我可以不参加吗？我不想掺和……不管这到底是什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, me neither. I don't even know what the fuck is going on right now.
lines.zh: : 还有我，我也不想。我他妈根本不知道现在在搞什么鬼。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions5
: You’d have a much easier time following along if you were here for the first part of class.
lines.zh: : 你要是前半节课也在，跟上进度会容易得多。

lines.en: : I had shit to do. And if I knew we were gonna be doing some weird group thing, I wouldn’t have shown up at all.
lines.zh: : 我有事要忙。而且我要是早知道要搞这种莫名其妙的集体活动，我根本就不会来。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions6
: You may {i}not{/i} be excused, Io. Not until we figure out who you’re going to be competing against.
lines.zh: : 不行，Io，{i}不能{/i}缺席。至少得等我们弄清楚你要跟谁比。

lines.en: : Why do I have to compete against anyone? I’ve made it very apparent that I would like to be left alone forever.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要跟任何人比？我已经说得很清楚了，我想一个人待着，永远如此。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions7
: Because {i}all{/i} of us need to be involved or it won’t be a true bonding experience! Can you at least {i}try{/i} participating? For me?
lines.zh: : 因为我们{i}所有{/i}人都得参与进来，否则这就不是真正的联谊了！你能不能至少{i}试着{/i}参加一下？为了我？

lines.en: : I suppose I wouldn’t mind Io bailing out of the competition, but it would give my floor one extra point by default, so-
lines.zh: : 我倒是不介意 Io 退出比赛，但那样我们楼层会白得一分，所以——

lines.en: scene dormdecisions8
: Hey! Yumi said she wasn’t going to participate either, so if we’re doing things that way-
lines.zh: : 嘿！Yumi 也说了她不参加，如果按这个搞法——

lines.en: : Yumi will absolutely participate because, if she doesn’t, I have a complete log of her absences that I will be forwarding to the principal.
lines.zh: : Yumi 绝对会参加的，因为如果她不参加，我手上有一份她缺勤的完整记录，我会把它转交给校长。

lines.en: : You have what?! The fuck?!
lines.zh: : 你有什么？！你他妈？！

lines.en: : Heheh...I was wondering when this would come in handy.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我就在想这东西什么时候能派上用场。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions9
: Soooooo...
: Iooooooo...pleeeeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : Iooooooo……求——你——了？

lines.en: : I’ll never ask you for anything ever again.
lines.zh: : 我以后再也不会求你任何事了。

lines.en: : I am absolutely not going to believe that. Sorry, Uta.
lines.zh: : 这句话我绝对不信。抱歉，Uta。

lines.en: : And I absolutely don’t give a rat’s ass about {i}what{/i} you do with my fuckin’ “absence list.”
lines.zh: : 还有，你爱{i}怎么{/i}处置我那份“缺勤清单”，我他妈根本不在乎。

lines.en: : The fuck’s the principal gonna even do? If he tries to start somethin’ I’ll just kick his ass and be done with it. Easy.
lines.zh: : 校长还能拿我怎样？他要敢找事，我就揍他一顿完事。简单。

lines.en: : Sure, if you want to get kicked out of[school] at age [[redacted], feel free to do exactly that.
lines.zh: : 行啊，如果你想在 [[redacted] 岁被[school]开除，尽管这么做好了。

lines.en: : Woah. There it is again.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。又来了。

lines.en: : How is she doing that?
lines.zh: : 她到底是怎么做到的？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions10
: You know...maybe we could just put those two up against each other?
lines.zh: : 那个……要不我们让她俩互相较量一下？

lines.en: : I don’t know if it’s a good idea to ask our classmates to engage in combat.
lines.zh: : 我不确定让同班同学互相动手是不是个好主意。

lines.en: : Actually, yeah. That sounds fine. I’m in.
lines.zh: : 其实吧，听起来还行。我参加。

lines.en: : I am not in. Not at all. She’s twice my size and I don’t even like fighting.
lines.zh: : 我不参加。完全不。她块头是我的两倍，而且我根本不喜欢打架。

lines.en: : Woo! Io surrenders! One point goes to the first floor!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Io 认输了！一楼得一分！

lines.en: : I didn’t mean making ‘em fight...I was thinking something more like whoever can get one of them to join in on the fun first wins.
lines.zh: : 我不是说让她们打架啦……我想的是，谁先让她俩中的一个参与进来，谁就赢。

lines.en: : It would also save us some time since it would take place over the entire contest rather than a set time and place.
lines.zh: : 这样还能省点时间，因为这项比赛会贯穿整场赛事，而不是定死在某时某地。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions11
: That works for me. Yumi’s shown up to several class functions in the past, so it shouldn’t be {i}too{/i} hard getting her to do it again.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。Yumi 以前参加过好几次班级活动，再让她参加一次应该{i}不难{/i}。

lines.en: : Wait, so we’re not fighting?
lines.zh: : 等等，所以我们不打架？

lines.en: : No. Pay attention.
lines.zh: : 不打。专心点。

lines.en: : Well then what the fuck? I don’t want to do this anymore.
lines.zh: : 那他妈还有什么意思？我不想参加了。

lines.en: : It’s settled then. Our first of ten battles will be the wallflower cooperation contest! Whoever does something with the rest of us first wins!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了。十场比赛中的第一场，就是“壁花合作赛”！谁先跟我们一起做了点什么，谁就赢！

lines.en: : Done.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : And I actually already have something in mind for the next contest.
lines.zh: : 而且我已经想好下一场要比什么了。

lines.en: : Ooooooh, what is it? Something glasses based?
lines.zh: : 噢噢噢，是什么？跟眼镜有关的？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions12
: There’s more to me than just my glasses, you know. I have interests and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我可不只有眼镜，你知道吧。我有兴趣爱好什么的。

lines.en: : Some sorta test of knowledge thingy then?
lines.zh: : 那就是某种知识竞答之类的？

lines.en: : Well...yes. A standard test of knowledge would be more than sufficient in determining which floor excels in at least {i}that{/i} area.
lines.zh: : 嗯……对。一场标准的知识测验，足以判断哪一楼层至少在{i}这个{/i}方面更胜一筹。

lines.en: : Fine by me, but I think you might be bitin’ off a little more than you can chew here.
lines.zh: : 我没意见，不过我觉得你这次可能有点贪多嚼不烂了。

lines.en: : I know you’re smart and all, but we’ve got a bit of a prodigy on our floor.
lines.zh: : 我知道你很聪明，但我们楼层可是有个天才。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions13
: And from out of the darkness emerges the true secret weapon of the second floor. The unending fountain of knowledge that is Molly MacCormack.
lines.zh: : 而黑暗中浮现出了二楼真正的秘密武器。那座取之不尽的知识之泉——Molly MacCormack。

lines.en: : Blessed with the gift of foresight...experienced in all forms of trials and tribulations...is a mystical warrior of emerald, ready to carry her clan to the next-
lines.zh: : 受预言天赋眷顾……历经一切试炼与磨难……是一位翡翠色的神秘战士，随时准备带领她的族人迈向下一个——

lines.en: scene dormdecisions14
: I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 我来。

lines.en: : Wha-?!
: Molly, you didn’t really think Uta was talking about you, right?
lines.zh: : Molly，你该不会真以为 Uta 说的是你吧？

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t she be?! I’m smart! Very smart!
lines.zh: : 为什么不是我？！我很聪明！非常聪明！

lines.en: : How much could Nodoka possibly know about the dark arts?!
lines.zh: : Nodoka 对黑魔法能知道多少啊？！

lines.en: : Why did your mind immediately go to “the dark arts” after hearing “test of knowledge?”
lines.zh: : 听到“知识测验”之后，你的脑子为什么立刻就跳到了“黑魔法”？

lines.en: : And there she is! Our savior!
lines.zh: : 她来了！我们的救星！

lines.en: : Heh. I was wondering if you’d volunteer.
lines.zh: : 呵。我还在想你会不会自告奋勇。

lines.en: : I‘ve looked into your history and know you have the upper hand when it comes to test scores, but to agree to face off with me directly is-
lines.zh: : 我查过你的履历，知道你在考试成绩上占优，但肯直接站出来跟我对决这件事——

lines.en: scene dormdecisions15
: Oh, I’m not trying to prove I’m smarter than you or anything. I really don’t care about that.
lines.zh: : 哦，我并不是想证明我比你聪明什么的。我真不在乎那个。

lines.en: : I just want to avoid doing anything physical, so this is probably the best bet for me.
lines.zh: : 我只是想躲开一切体力活，所以这对我来说大概是最优选。

lines.en: : Also, I wouldn’t mind sleeping in the same room with Sensei as it means there is a higher likelihood of something {i}exciting{/i} happening.
lines.zh: : 另外，我也不介意睡在 Sensei 同一个房间里，因为那样有更大的概率发生点{i}有意思{/i}的事。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions16
: Nodoka...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……

lines.en: : There sure as heck isn’t!
lines.zh: : 绝对不会有！

lines.en: : Unless our floor wins. Then there is a very high likelihood of-
lines.zh: : 除非我们这层赢了。那概率就非常高了——

lines.en: : Ayane! Not now!
lines.zh: : Ayane！现在不是说这个的时候！

lines.en: scene dormdecisions17
: Cool! So now that we’ve got two contests out of the way, how about we handle the other basic skills before gettin’ into the weird stuff?
lines.zh: : 酷！既然已经搞定两场比赛了，在进入那些奇怪的项目之前，我们不如先把基础技能类的处理掉？

lines.en: : I volunteer for the weird stuff!
lines.zh: : 我要报名奇怪的项目！

lines.en: : Like, who can stay in a locked room with Sensei without any food or water for the longest?! I want that contest!
lines.zh: : 比如，谁能跟 Sensei 一起被锁在一个房间里、不吃不喝撑得最久？！我要这个项目！

lines.en: : I accept this challenge! I was born for this!
lines.zh: : 我接受挑战！我天生就是干这个的！

lines.en: : Ummm...no!
lines.zh: : 呃——不行！

lines.en: : We’ll get to the weird stuff in a sec, but since we already have a test of knowledge going, why not try for a test of courage?
lines.zh: : 奇怪的项目我们待会儿再说，不过既然已经有知识测验了，不如再来个胆量测试？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions18
: What is a test of courage?
lines.zh: : 什么是胆量测试？

lines.en: : Are you going to tie our hands behind our backs and force us to walk the plank of a pirate ship?
lines.zh: : 你们是要把我们的手绑在背后，逼我们走海盗船的跳板吗？

lines.en: : Why would you immediately assume that is what a test of courage is?
lines.zh: : 你为什么立刻就认定胆量测试是这个？

lines.en: : Apologies, but the Kendo Princess and I watched the Pirates of the Caribbean series recently and she is now strangely obsessed with pirates.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过剑道公主和我最近一起看了《加勒比海盗》系列，她现在对海盗有种诡异的执念。

lines.en: : Shivering timbers. Hoist up the delightful Roger.
lines.zh: : 抖成筛子的船板。升起那面愉快的罗杰旗吧。

lines.en: : Maya, if it’s a test of courage, why don’t you volunteer?
lines.zh: : Maya，既然是胆量测试，你为什么不报名？

lines.en: : Yeah! You’re basically emotionless, so I think you’d be great.
lines.zh: : 对呀！你基本上没有任何情绪波动，我觉得你肯定很合适。

lines.en: : Isn’t Sensei supposed to be the judge? How will he score a test of courage?
lines.zh: : Sensei 不是应该当裁判吗？胆量测试他要怎么打分？

lines.en: : Huh...I mean, I guess he doesn’t {i}have{/i} to be the judge of every category, does he?
lines.zh: : 哈……我猜他也不是每个项目都{i}必须{/i}当裁判吧？

lines.en: : The contest between Nodoka and me will have a clear victor, so he probably doesn’t need to be involved in that either.
lines.zh: : 我和 Nodoka 之间的比赛胜负很明确，所以那场大概也不需要他介入。

lines.en: : I’m fine with some Sensei-less fights. Especially since Sensei would probably be biased toward Maya anyway.
lines.zh: : 我赞成搞几场 Sensei 不参与的比赛。尤其是因为 Sensei 大概本来就偏袒 Maya。

lines.en: : Agreed.
lines.zh: : 同意。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions19
: He would be biased {i}against{/i} me, is what I’m going to assume you meant to say.
lines.zh: : 我想你要说的是——他会{i}对我{/i}有成见。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be involved in any contest where he is the judge because it will put my team at a disadvantage.
lines.zh: : 凡是他当裁判的项目我都不想参加，因为那会让我的队伍处于劣势。

lines.en: : I also volunteer to join the pirate contest.
lines.zh: : 我也报名加入海盗项目。

lines.en: : No pirates, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 没有海盗，剑道公主。

lines.en: : A test of courage is where you have to try not to get scared. And Maya’s stat in courage is extraordinarily high, so she will be quite the adversary.
lines.zh: : 胆量测试就是看你能不能忍住不害怕。而且 Maya 的勇气数值高得离谱，她会是个相当棘手的对手。

lines.en: : Argh.
: Tsuneyo Tojo accepts the terms and will compete regardless.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo Tojo 接受条件，无论如何都会参赛。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions20
: I think that’s settled then. Though, I wasn’t thinking we meant things like “bravery” when we began tossing out the ideas of tests in basic ability.
lines.zh: : 我想这就定了吧。不过，我们一开始抛出“基础能力测试”这个点子的时候，我指的可不是“勇敢”之类的东西。

lines.en: : Fear is something we’ve all gotta deal with, Makoto. And besides, it’s a lot more interesting than two nerds trying to be smart at each other.
lines.zh: : 恐惧是我们每个人都要面对的东西，Makoto。再说了，这可比两个书呆子对着秀智商有意思多了。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions21
: Well forgive me for trying to make things competitive! At least I’m not suggesting locking ourselves in a room with someone and competing over that!
lines.zh: : 行吧，我为了增加竞争性还真是抱歉！至少我没有提议把自己和别人锁在一个房间里、然后拿这个来比赛！

lines.en: : Oh! Me! We’re at my competition!
lines.zh: : 噢！我！轮到我的项目了！

lines.en: scene dormdecisions22
: If you want something involving basic skills or whatever, why not put two of the athletic girls against each other?
lines.zh: : 如果你们想要涉及基础技能之类的，为什么不让两个擅长运动的女生互相比一场？

lines.en: : Woah, Kirin. You actually takin’ an interest in stuff like that?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，Kirin。你居然对这种事情感兴趣？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions23
: What do you mean, “taking?” We’ve been playing soccer together for how long now?
lines.zh: : “居然”是什么意思？我们在一起踢足球都踢了多久了？

lines.en: : A while, but you’re always spendin’ practice on your phone or talkin’ to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 挺久了，可你训练的时候要么一直玩手机，要么一直在跟 Sensei 说话。

lines.en: : No offense to you, Kirin...but are you really sure that’s the sort of competition you want to suggest?
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，Kirin……但你真的确定要提这种比赛吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure Miku would be willing to go up against you, but I can’t help but think you’d be at a disadvantage due to Miku’s...natural talent.
lines.zh: : 我相信 Miku 会愿意跟你比，但我忍不住觉得你会吃亏，因为 Miku 有……天生的才能。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions24
: Hey! Ain’t nothin’ natural about it! I work really hard!
lines.zh: : 嘿！那才不是天生的！我练得很辛苦！

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} would like to prove that I’ve been working plenty hard outside of practice.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}想证明，我在训练之外也下了不少功夫。

lines.en: : I just prefer to work out on my own.
lines.zh: : 我只是更喜欢自己一个人练。

lines.en: : Besides, even if I lose, I’ll be going up against somebody I like.
lines.zh: : 再说了，就算我输了，对手也是我喜欢的人。

lines.en: : And if this whole thing is gonna be about bonding or blah blah blah, it only makes sense to compete with someone you care about.
lines.zh: : 如果这一整件事的意义在于“增进感情”什么的，那跟你在乎的人比才说得通。

lines.en: : And Miku? You’re okay with this challenge?
lines.zh: : 那 Miku 呢？你接受这个挑战吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...now I feel kinda bad for sayin’ Kirin wasn’t interested.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过……我现在有点后悔说 Kirin 不感兴趣了。

lines.en: : Well, as long as you don’t plan on taking it easy on her, I’m sure everything will be fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧，只要你别打算对她放水，我相信一切都会顺利。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions25
: What do I get to do?
lines.zh: : 那我能做什么？

lines.en: : Oh, Yasuyasu! You actually want to participate?
lines.zh: : 哦，Yasuyasu！你居然想参加？

lines.en: : It sounds fun, but I’m afraid I’m not very good at many things.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺有意思的，但恐怕我没什么擅长的东西。

lines.en: : That actually works out just fine! Cause I kinda had a thing already in mind for you and Sana.
lines.zh: : 那正好！因为我心里已经替你和 Sana 想好了一个项目。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions26
: Wha-
: Me?!
: Unless you changed your name recently.
lines.zh: : 除非你最近改了名字。

lines.en: : Actually, if you change your name now, there might still be a chance to get out of this.
lines.zh: : 其实，你要是现在就改名字，说不定还来得及逃过这一劫。

lines.en: : But...But I...
lines.zh: : 可是……可是我……

lines.en: : I don’t really...know her...and...
lines.zh: : 我真的不……认识她……而且……

lines.en: : I didn’t really think I was...involved in this...
lines.zh: : 我真没觉得自己……跟这事有什么关系……

lines.en: : Sana, everybody’s involved in this.
lines.zh: : Sana，所有人都跟这事有关系。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m sure whatever it is will be totally normal and not embarrassing at all. So you’ll just be able to cruise by.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我敢肯定不管是什么项目都绝对正常、一点都不丢人。所以你躺平就行。

lines.en: : Yasuyasu, you and Sana will be facing off against each other in a gothic lolita fashion show.
lines.zh: : Yasuyasu，你和 Sana 要比的是哥特萝莉时装秀。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions27
: AHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！

lines.en: : Or it will be insanely embarrassing and you’ll just have to deal with it because I want to see you in cute clothes. Sorry, not sorry.
lines.zh: : 或者它会尴尬到离谱，而你就只能认了，因为我想看你穿可爱的衣服。抱歉，但我并不抱歉。

lines.en: : Is Sensei going to be the only judge for that contest or are there going to be others involved as well?
lines.zh: : 那场比赛是只有 Sensei 当裁判，还是也会有其他人参与？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions28
: He’ll be the only judge, but we can all get involved in any way we want.
lines.zh: : 只有他当裁判，不过我们其他人想怎么参与都行。

lines.en: : Sana and Yasuyasu are kinda like Yumi and Io. They’re pretty quiet most of the time and I figured they might need a little push and some help from the rest of their team.
lines.zh: : Sana 和 Yasuyasu 有点像 Yumi 和 Io。她们平时都挺安静的，我觉得可能需要团队里其他人推一把、帮一把。

lines.en: : So all you two really need to do is keep on bein’ cute and we’ll use you as our final projects! It’ll be kinda like the main event of the whole thingie.
lines.zh: : 所以你们俩只要继续可可爱爱的就行，我们会把你们当成我们的毕业设计！大概就当是整个活动的压轴大戏。

lines.en: : The two of them do wear nothing but dresses outside of[school] so...I can see this being a pretty even contest.
lines.zh: 她们俩在[school]之外确实只穿裙子，所以……我猜这会是一场势均力敌的比赛。

lines.en: : Couldn’t Sensei just play favorites for that, though?
lines.zh: : 可 Sensei 会不会直接偏心？

lines.en: : If he’s the judge, what’s going to stop him from just picking the girl he thinks is hotter or whatever?
lines.zh: : 如果他是裁判，有什么能阻止他直接挑他觉得更辣的那个之类的？

lines.en: : Isn’t that the whole point? Just be quiet and accept that you’re going to have to see cute girls in cute clothes. Woe is you.
lines.zh: : 那样不才是重点吗？闭上嘴，接受你将要看可爱女生穿可爱衣服这件事吧。真是难为你了。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions29
if rinbetrayed == False:
: I don’t think we need to worry about him being biased or anything. He’s normally pretty good about not doing that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不用担心他会偏心什么的。他这方面平时做得挺好。

lines.en: else:
: I don’t think we need to worry about bias as long as it’s those two we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 只要说的是她们俩，我就不觉得需要担心偏心。

lines.en: : Don’t know if I can say the same for some of the others, though. Not with his history.
lines.zh: : 不过换成其他人就说不准了。鉴于他的前科。

lines.en: : Wait, what? What history?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？什么前科？

lines.en: : Hah...
: Well, while there’s no way to guarantee that there is no bias involved, there are preventative measures we can take to ensure that it does not happen in every contest.
lines.zh: : 虽然没法保证完全没有偏袒，但我们可以采取一些预防措施，确保不会每场比赛都出这种事。

lines.en: : Exactly! Which is why another brilliant idea just popped into my head! One that is the complete opposite of Sensei choosing girls he likes the most.
lines.zh: : 正是！所以我脑子里又蹦出了一个绝妙的点子！一个跟“Sensei 挑他最喜欢的女生”完全相反的点子！

lines.en: : Are you thinking what I’m thinking, Makoto?!
lines.zh: : 你在想我想的事吗，Makoto？！

lines.en: : Probably not, Uta.
lines.zh: : 大概不是，Uta。

lines.en: : Friend zone battle!
lines.zh: : 朋友区大战！

lines.en: scene dormdecisions2
: ...What?
: Did you know that they used to call me the “girl whisperer” in middle[school]?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我上初中的时候，别人都管我叫“少女低语者”。

lines.en: : No one ever called you that. We went to middle[school] together.
lines.zh: : 从来没人这么叫过你。我们可是同一所初中的。

lines.en: : They did talk about your boobs, though.
lines.zh: : 不过他们确实聊过你的胸。

lines.en: : And they likely will forever. I have already accepted this.
lines.zh: : 而且大概会一直聊下去。我早就接受了。

lines.en: : Yes. You have large breasts for such a small girl. But what does that have to do with the friend zone?
lines.zh: : 是啊。对你这么小个子的女孩来说，胸部确实很大。可这跟朋友区有什么关系？

lines.en: : Absolutely nothing. But what I’m saying is if we’re so worried about Sensei’s biased judgement, why not put the girl who thinks he won’t be biased at all up against the one who’s sure he will?
lines.zh: : 一点关系都没有。但我想说的是，既然我们这么担心 Sensei 的评判有偏颇，为什么不把觉得他完全不会偏心的那个女生，和确信他会偏心的那个放在一起比？

lines.en: : You mean Rin and Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你是说 Rin 和 Otoha？

lines.en: : Yeah! We already know that neither of them have any romantic feelings for him, so there’s literally nothing to lose.
lines.zh: : 对呀！我们已经知道她们俩对他都没有那种感情，所以根本没什么好损失的。

lines.en: : Is that...really a thing we know?
lines.zh: : 这……我们真的知道吗？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions30
: How would a friend zone battle work exactly?
lines.zh: : 朋友区大战具体要比什么？

lines.en: : Cause if we’re playing that game where we try to not get nervous and slowly move our hands closer and closer to each other’s-
lines.zh: : 因为如果是那种“看谁先不紧张、把手一点点往对方手里挪”的游戏——

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t really think that’s what they’re going for, Rin.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得她们要的不是那个，Rin。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
: Okay, good. Because I’m pretty sure I would not last very long.
lines.zh: : 好，那就好。因为我敢肯定我撑不了多久。

lines.en: else:
: Okay, just making sure.
lines.zh: : 好的，确认一下而已。

lines.en: : Basically, we put the two of you at different tables and just let Sensei run wild.
lines.zh: : 基本上，就是把你们俩安排在不同的桌子，然后让 Sensei 撒开了玩。

lines.en: : Hi, Noriko again. Is there any rule against competing in more than one competition?
lines.zh: : 嗨，又是我 Noriko。请问有没有规定不能参加多个项目？

lines.en: : Hey, Ayane here. Same question.
lines.zh: : 嗨，这里是 Ayane。同样的问题。

lines.en: : Hi, Nodoka speaking. Is there any rule against filming this “running wild” that you speak of?
lines.zh: : 嗨，Nodoka 发言。请问把你说的这个“撒开了玩”拍下来违不违规？

lines.en: : Um, hello! Makoto’s turn! Can you all be quiet so we can figure this thing out?
lines.zh: : 喂，你好！轮到 Makoto 了！你们能不能安静点，好让我们把这事定下来？

lines.en: : Is it not figured out already? Just put ‘em at a table and whoever lasts the longest without flirting back wins.
lines.zh: : 这还没定下来吗？把她俩放在一张桌子上，谁忍住不回撩最久谁就赢。

lines.en: : And no, Noriko and Ayane. You can’t compete because you’d both lose immediately.
lines.zh: : 还有，不行，Noriko 和 Ayane。你们不能参加，因为你们俩会立刻就输。

lines.en: : You know, that’s fair. I get it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话公平。我懂了。

lines.en: : I just texted him a winky face so I probably lost already.
lines.zh: : 我刚给他发了个眨眼表情，所以我大概已经输了。

lines.en: : Ooh! I should send him one too!
lines.zh: : 噢！我也该给他发一个！

lines.en: : If all we’re doing is just...not flirting with him, yeah. I’m down for that.
lines.zh: : 如果只是……不跟他调情的话，行。我参加。

lines.en: : I’ll probably make things so awkward that he won’t even want to flirt with me. So yeah, count me in too.
lines.zh: : 我大概会把气氛搞得特别尴尬，让他根本不想来撩我。所以也算我一个。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions31
: Uta, are we still doing the thing we said we were gonna do before this contest was even official?
lines.zh: : Uta，这场比赛还没正式立项之前我们说好的那件事，还算数吗？

lines.en: : Because if so, I want to apologize in advance for ruining our friendship.
lines.zh: : 因为如果算的话，我想提前为毁掉我们的友谊道个歉。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions32
: Oh right. You two have been planning this for a while, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 对了。你们俩筹划这个有一阵子了吧？

lines.en: : What sort of contest did the two of you have in mind for each other?
lines.zh: : 你们俩心里想跟对方比什么？

lines.en: : Well, it wasn’t originally part of the contest thingy, but Ayane and I have been talking about freestyle rap battling each other since I transferred in.
lines.zh: : 嗯，本来不在比赛项目里的，不过自从我转学过来，我和 Ayane 就一直在说要比一场自由说唱。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions33
: Oooooookay! So with the rap rampage added to the list, that leaves us with six girls who have yet to be matched up!
lines.zh: : 好————吧！那么加上“说唱狂潮”，我们还剩六个女生没有配对！

lines.en: : Correct. From the first floor, we still have Ami, Futaba, and Chika.
lines.zh: : 没错。一楼这边还剩 Ami、Futaba 和 Chika。

lines.en: : And from the better floor, we have Touka, Noriko, and I guess Molly.
lines.zh: : 而更优秀的这层楼，有 Touka、Noriko，还有……大概 Molly 吧。

lines.en: : What do you mean, “you guess?!” Why are you so mean to me today?!
lines.zh: : “大概”是什么意思？！你今天为什么对我这么刻薄？！

lines.en: scene dormdecisions34
: Regardless, if we’re bringing past discussions into the debate...I, too, have a suggestion for the battle between Futaba and me.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，既然要把旧账翻出来讨论……我对 Futaba 和我之间的对战也有个提议。

lines.en: : You do?
lines.zh: : 你有？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions35
: Yes. Several months ago, you made an offhand comment about how Sana’s Zagull Throat Spear could defeat my monk in one on one combat, to which I was very offended.
lines.zh: : 是的。几个月前，你随口说过一句，Sana 的扎古尔喉枪能在一对一里打败我的武僧，当时我深受冒犯。

lines.en: : I intend to make you pay dearly for those words and hereby challenge you, Futaba Fukuyama, to put your gil where your mouth is and prove it.
lines.zh: : 我要让你为那些话付出惨痛的代价，特此向你挑战，Futaba Fukuyama——有本事就拿出真章来证明给我看。

lines.en: : Gills are near the mouth, but not on them, Emerald Guardian. You are thinking of “teeth.”
lines.zh: : 鳃是在嘴附近，但不在嘴上，翡翠守护者。你想说的是“牙齿”。

lines.en: : Silence, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Um...I mean...if there’s nothing else we can think of...
lines.zh: : 呃……我是说……如果实在想不出别的……

lines.en: : I guess I'm okay with that...
lines.zh: : 我猜我可以接受……

lines.en: : One more down! Two to go!
lines.zh: : 又搞定一个！还剩两个！

lines.en: scene dormdecisions36
: You feeling okay, Touka? You’ve barely said anything since class started?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Touka？从上课到现在你几乎没说过话？

lines.en: : Huh? Yeah. I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我很好。

lines.en: : I’m just not really sure what’s happening right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是不太确定现在在发生什么。

lines.en: : I’ve heard of group activities before, but from what I heard, it sounded like there’s normally a teacher involved.
lines.zh: : 我听说过集体活动，但据我所知，通常是有老师参与在里面的。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions37
: Well, hey. How about this? I already know what kind of contest I want to be in, and I’d be happy for you to compete as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那这样如何？我已经知道我想参加什么比赛了，也很乐意让你一起参加。

lines.en: : I'd just need to know that you’re not going to try anything sneaky.
lines.zh: : 我只是需要确认你不会耍什么花招。

lines.en: : And also that you’re not secretly in love with our teacher.
lines.zh: : 还有，你没有偷偷暗恋我们的老师。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions38
: Wha?! Of course I’m not! That’s absurd!
lines.zh: : 什么？！我当然没有！太荒谬了！

lines.en: : Great! Then-
lines.zh: : 太好了！那么——

lines.en: : Hey! The heck are you sayin' to my teammate that’s gettin’ her all flustered back there?!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你在后面对我队友说什么呢，把人家说得脸红成那样？！

lines.en: : Know your place, woman!
lines.zh: : 搞清楚你的身份，女人！

lines.en: scene dormdecisions39
: Touka and I want to go on a date with Sensei!
lines.zh: : Touka 和我都想去跟 Sensei 约会！

lines.en: : Get in line. Like half the reason we’re even having this contest is because all of us want that.
lines.zh: : 排队去。我们办这个比赛有一半的原因就是大家都想那样。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t get him just because you shouted it out loud.
lines.zh: : 你不能因为嗓门大就独占他。

lines.en: : If it worked that way, Sensei and I would be on a romantic getaway in Kyoto right now.
lines.zh: : 要是这招有用的话，我和 Sensei 现在就在京都度浪漫假期了。

lines.en: : I...didn't say I wanted to...
lines.zh: : 我……我没说我想……

lines.en: scene dormdecisions40
: Uhhh...thanks for sharin’ and stuff, but that’s not really a thing we’re talkin’ about right now.
lines.zh: : 呃……谢谢你分享之类的，不过我们现在聊的真不是这个。

lines.en: : If you want to go on a date or whatever, just ask him.
lines.zh: : 你想约会什么的，直接去问他就行了。

lines.en: : No, no, no. Like a contest to see who can throw the better date.
lines.zh: : 不不不。是比谁能安排出更好的约会的比赛。

lines.en: : You guys can even come watch to make sure nothing weird happens.
lines.zh: : 你们甚至可以来看，确保不会发生什么奇怪的事。

lines.en: : Not like it ever {i}would{/i}, anyway. Sensei’s like, waaaaaay above that.
lines.zh: : 反正也根本不{i}会{/i}发生。Sensei 可是……远远高于那种事的人。

lines.en: : Which Sensei? Our Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哪个 Sensei？我们的 Sensei？

lines.en: : Is this a joke?
lines.zh: : 这是在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : Come on, Makoto! Don’t you want to win?
lines.zh: : 拜托，Makoto！你就不想赢吗？

lines.en: : Well, yes. But not if it means breaking[school] rules and subjecting students to anything inappropriate or-
lines.zh: : 嗯，想。但如果那意味着违反[school]规定、让学生接触到任何不适当的东西，或者——

lines.en: : Oh, speaking of inappropriate, I could have sworn I saw you walking out of some seedy looking shop the other day.
lines.zh: : 哦，说到不适当，我发誓前两天看见你从一家看起来很可疑的店里走出来。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions41
: I’m not really sure what kind of place it was. But it would certainly seem really inappropriate if our class rep was spending time in some-
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定那是什么地方。不过，如果我们班干部在这种地方消磨时间，听起来确实相当不适当——

lines.en: : Wait! Okay, yeah! I’m fine with the contest thing so long as we can supervise it!
lines.zh: : 等等！好吧，行！只要能让我们监督，这个比赛我没意见！

lines.en: : You hangin’ out in weird places, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你居然会逛那种奇怪的地方，Makoto？

lines.en: : No...she must have me confused with someone else.
lines.zh: : 没有……她一定是把我认成别人了。

lines.en: : I have...one of those faces, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我大概……长了张大众脸吧。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions42
: So...I guess this means it’s me and Noriko up against each other?
lines.zh: : 那么……看来是我和 Noriko 对决了？

lines.en: : It looks that way, but...I’m kinda out of ideas on what we could have you do.
lines.zh: : 看起来是这样，不过……我有点想不出能让你们俩比什么。

lines.en: : Yeah...I don’t really know what we could do for the two of them either.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我也不知道能为她们俩安排什么。

lines.en: : And we are absolutely not going with Noriko’s idea of locking them in a room together.
lines.zh: : 而且我们绝对不会采纳 Noriko 那个把她们锁在一个房间里的主意。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions43
: Ami, what do you and I have more in common than anything else?
lines.zh: : Ami，我和你最共同的东西是什么？

lines.en: : Just think. It’s not hard.
lines.zh: : 想想看。不难。

lines.en: : Well...I obviously know the answer, but I don’t really like the idea of competing over it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我当然知道答案，但我不太喜欢拿这个来比。

lines.en: : I don’t like Chika’s contest either, but since there are going to be other people there, I can’t really do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 我也不喜欢 Chika 那个比赛，不过既然会有其他人在场，我也实在做不了什么。

lines.en: : Then let’s do something of our own! We can have chaperones too!
lines.zh: : 那我们就搞自己的项目！我们也可以有监护人！

lines.en: : I certainly don’t care about anyone seeing me with Sensei, do you?
lines.zh: : 我当然不介意被别人看到我和 Sensei 在一起，你呢？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions44
: I’d actually {i}prefer{/i} if people saw me with Sensei. It would make so many things significantly easier.
lines.zh: : 我倒{i}更希望{/i}被人看到我和 Sensei 在一起。那样很多事情都会简单得多。

lines.en: : Great! Then, how about a...best [niece] battle or something?
lines.zh: : 太好了！那么，来一场……最佳[niece]大战之类的？

lines.en: : Are you on drugs? You’d have absolutely no chance of winning.
lines.zh: : 你嗑药了吗？你一点赢的机会都没有。

lines.en: : I am the ultimate [niece]. I exist to please my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 我是终极[niece]。我为取悦我的[uncle]而存在。

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : Is it getting hot in here, or...?
lines.zh: : 是不是有点热起来了，还是……？

lines.en: scene dormdecisions45
: What about...an imouto war?
lines.zh: : 那……来一场妹妹战争？

lines.en: : Do you think you could function as a little sister instead of a [niece]? Or are you so used to your current power dynamic that you’d crumble under the pressure?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能改当妹妹、而不是[niece]吗？还是说你已经太习惯现在这种权力关系，一换就会在压力下崩溃？

lines.en: : I think that any competition involving my relationship with Sensei would be a death sentence for anyone stupid enough to challenge me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得任何涉及我和 Sensei 关系的比赛，对任何蠢到敢挑战我的人来说都是死刑。

lines.en: : But if you insist, I wouldn’t mind crushing you and leaving you to rot in one of the dumpsters on the side of our house.
lines.zh: : 不过你非要这样的话，我也不介意把你碾碎，然后丢在我家旁边某个垃圾箱里烂掉。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions46
: Isn’t that a little harsh? I’m just trying to get closer to you over a little friendly competition.
lines.zh: : 是不是有点太狠了？我只是想在一场友好的比赛里跟你拉近距离而已。

lines.en: : He’s like family to me, so it also makes you kind of like a sister and-
lines.zh: : 他对我来说就像家人，所以你在我心里也算是妹妹，而且——

lines.en: : Blah blah blah. I accept your challenge.
lines.zh: :  blah blah blah。我接受你的挑战。

lines.en: : But you should probably apologize in advance to your team for losing them the opportunity to sleep in the same room as my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 不过你大概该提前给你的队友道个歉，因为你会害他们失去睡在我[uncle]同一个房间里的机会。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions47
: Okay. Well, that was weird. But I’m pretty sure we have all of our contests now.
lines.zh: : 好。嗯，那可真够怪的。不过我基本确定所有比赛项目都齐了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : So...just to clarify, what are the two of them going up against each other in?
lines.zh: : 那么……确认一下，她们俩到底要比什么？

lines.en: : I think it’s like...a fight to see who the better little sister is?
lines.zh: : 我觉得就是……比谁更适合当妹妹？

lines.en: : But Sensei is like, way older than both of them. So for them to even be his little sisters would mean his mom and dad are still gettin' freaky like, way late in life.
lines.zh: : 可 Sensei 比她们俩都大那么多。要让她们当他的妹妹，那他爸妈得相当晚还在那啥才行。

lines.en: : But I guess my parents still get it on too, so-
lines.zh: : 不过我猜我爸妈现在也还在那啥，所以——

lines.en: scene dormdecisions48
: Okay! Well, uhh...class dismissed!
lines.zh: : 好了！那么，呃……下课！

lines.en: : If you signed up to be a commentator, please go retrieve the necessary equipment from the broadcasting club and be sure to put down your name and the exact items you took!
lines.zh: : 报名当解说员的，请去广播社领取必要器材，记得登记姓名和你领走的具体物品！

lines.en: : The competition begins bright and early tomorrow, so feel free to spend the rest of the[school] day and any time afterward strategizing.
lines.zh: : 比赛明天一大早开始，剩下的[school]时间和之后的时间，你们都可以自由地制定策略。

lines.en: : Wow, it’s like you don’t even want to hear about my parents knockin’ boots. You’re even more of a prude than I am.
lines.zh: : 哇，你看起来完全不想听我爸妈行房的事。你比我还要保守。

lines.en: scene dormdecisions49
: I can absolutely not wait to destroy both your team and you...
lines.zh: : 我真是等不及要碾碎你的队伍和你本人了……

lines.en: scene black
